title: Youth protest in Basel against rearmament and climate crisis

tea.why: Protesters demonstrated against rearmament, the climate crisis, and austerity measures affecting education.
tea.want: The protesters demanded action against the climate crisis, an end to rearmament, and the reversal of education budget cuts.
tea.changed: Nov 20: Police used water cannons, rubber bullets, and tear gas to disperse protesters in Basel following clashes.

summary: On November 20, 2026, thousands of students and young people participated in demonstrations across Switzerland, including Basel, to protest against rearmament, the climate crisis, and austerity measures in education. In Basel, a permitted march turned into a confrontation when a group of masked individuals set up barricades using construction fencing, trash containers, and street signs near the Wettsteinbrücke. According to the Basel-Stadt cantonal police, protesters attacked officers with fireworks, bottles, pyrotechnics, and a slingshot. The police intervened with water cannons, rubber bullets, and tear gas to prevent further escalation. While demonstrations in other cities like Bern remained peaceful, the event in Basel involved significant property damage and direct conflict between protesters and law enforcement.
response: The Basel-Stadt cantonal police stated they intervened to prevent escalation after protesters attacked officers with various projectiles and caused property damage. They deployed water cannons, rubber bullets, and tear gas.

updates.text: Thousands of young people protested across Switzerland against rearmament, climate change, and education cuts.
In Basel, a permitted march escalated into clashes, with police using water cannons and tear gas against protesters.
